---
name: "nf-core/fastq_fastqc_umitools_trimgalore"
description: "Read QC, UMI extraction and trimming"
keywords:
- "fastq"
- "fastqc"
- "qc"
- "UMI"
- "trimming"
- "trimgalore"
components:
- "fastqc"
- "umitools/extract"
- "trimgalore"
input:
- reads:
    type: "file"
    description: "List of input FastQ files of size 1 and 2 for single-end and paired-end\
      \ data,\nrespectively.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(reads) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fastq.gz}"
- skip_fastqc:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Skip fastqc process\n"
- with_umi:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "With or without umi detection\n"
- skip_umi_extract:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "With or without umi extrection\n"
- skip_trimming:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Allows to skip trimgalore execution\n"
- umi_discard_read:
    type: "integer"
    description: "Discard R1 / R2 if required\n"
- min_trimmed_reads:
    type: "integer"
    description: "Inputs with fewer than this reads will be filtered out of the \"\
      reads\" output channel\n"
output:
- reads:
    type: "file"
    description: "FastQ files after optional UMI extraction and adapter trimming,\
      \ filtered on\nthe minimum trimmed read count.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [\
      \ path(reads) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fastq.gz}"
- fastqc_html:
    type: "file"
    description: "FastQC report.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(html) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*_{fastqc.html}"
- fastqc_zip:
    type: "file"
    description: "FastQC report archive.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(zip) ]\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*_{fastqc.zip}"
- umi_log:
    type: "file"
    description: "Logfile for umi_tools.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(log) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{log}"
- umi_reads:
    type: "file"
    description: "Extracted FASTQ files. | For single-end reads, pattern is \\${prefix}.umi_extract.fastq.gz.\
      \ |\n\n\n\n  For paired-end reads, pattern is \\${prefix}.umi_extract_{1,2}.fastq.gz.\
      \ |\n\n\n\n  Structure: [ val(meta), [ path(reads) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fastq.gz}"
- trim_unpaired:
    type: "file"
    description: "FastQ files containing unpaired reads from read 1 or read 2.\n\n\
      Structure: [ val(meta), [ path(reads) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*unpaired*.fq.gz"
- trim_html:
    type: "file"
    description: "FastQC report (optional).\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(html)\
      \ ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*_{fastqc.html}"
- trim_zip:
    type: "file"
    description: "FastQC report archive (optional).\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(zip)\
      \ ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*_{fastqc.zip}"
- trim_log:
    type: "file"
    description: "Trim Galore! trimming report.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(txt)\
      \ ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*_{report.txt}"
- trim_json:
    type: "file"
    description: "Trim Galore! JSON report, consumed by MultiQC's trim_galore module\
      \ (optional).\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(json) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*report.json"
- trim_read_count:
    type: "integer"
    description: "Number of reads remaining after trimming for all input samples.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), val(count) ]\n"
authors:
- "@drpatelh"
- "@KamilMaliszArdigen"
maintainers:
- "@drpatelh"
- "@KamilMaliszArdigen"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/fastqc@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/umitools/extract@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/trimgalore@0.0.0-6d1763b"
